name: Random StartPos
description: Switches to a random StartPos every N deaths.

enabled.name: Enable Random StartPos
enabled.description: Master switch. When off the mod does no work at all, and (if 'Return To 0% When Turned Off' is on) your next respawn goes back to 0% when the mod had moved you to a StartPos. On levels with no StartPos the mod idles by itself.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: custom uses your settings. practice = weighted picks every 3 deaths. challenge = shuffle, every death. chaos = 40% chance per death. drill = stay until you stop improving. Presets override the trigger, mode and counts while selected.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Colour scheme for the pause panel, switch indicator, stats popup and the in-game menu.

switch-on-complete.name: Switch On Level Complete
switch-on-complete.description: Also pick a new StartPos when you beat the level.

trigger.name: Switch Trigger
trigger.description: deaths = after a number of deaths. chance = random chance on every death. streak = when you stop improving on a StartPos. Every death is counted.

deaths-until-switch.name: Deaths Until Switch
deaths-until-switch.description: Deaths before the StartPos changes (deaths trigger), or deaths in a row without beating your best (streak trigger). The switch happens the moment the counter hits zero. Default 3.

random-threshold.name: Randomize Death Count
random-threshold.description: Pick a random number between 'Deaths Until Switch' and 'Max Deaths' before each switch.

max-deaths.name: Max Deaths (Randomize)
max-deaths.description: Upper limit used when 'Randomize Death Count' is on.

chaos-chance.name: Chance Per Death (%)
chaos-chance.description: Chance of switching on each death when the trigger is 'chance'.

streak-tolerance.name: Streak Tolerance (%)
streak-tolerance.description: Streak trigger: a death must get this many percent farther than your best on the current StartPos to count as improving.

mode.name: Pick Mode
mode.description: random = any StartPos. shuffle = every StartPos once before any repeat. weighted = favors sections you die in most. next / previous / ping-pong = in order.

avoid-recent.name: Avoid Recent Picks
avoid-recent.description: random / weighted: never pick any of the last N StartPos again. 0 allows repeats. Default 2.

excluded.name: Excluded StartPos
excluded.description: Numbers of StartPos to never pick, separated by commas (numbered left to right from 1). Example: 1,4

include-level-start.name: Include Level Start
include-level-start.description: Also allow the very beginning of the level as a spawn.

use-seed.name: Seeded Sequence
use-seed.description: Same seed gives the same StartPos order every time (random and shuffle modes).

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Letters, numbers and dashes. Used when 'Seeded Sequence' is on.

practice-style.name: Practice Style
practice-style.description: off = use the trigger. beat = stay on a StartPos until you pass it. build = start at the last StartPos and move one section earlier after each clear.

passes-needed.name: Passes Needed (Beat)
passes-needed.description: Beat style: how many times you must get past the next StartPos before moving on.

give-up-after.name: Give Up After (Beat)
give-up-after.description: Beat style: move on anyway after this many deaths on one StartPos. 0 never gives up.

clears-needed.name: Clears Needed (Build-up)
clears-needed.description: Build-up style: level completions from a StartPos before the start moves one section earlier.

loop-build.name: Loop Build-up
loop-build.description: When build-up reaches the first StartPos, start over from the last one.

show-indicator.name: Show Switch Indicator
show-indicator.description: A subtle note, low on the screen, that appears as you die and shows which StartPos you are about to go to.

indicator-size.name: Indicator Size
indicator-size.description: Text size of the switch indicator.

indicator-height.name: Indicator Height (%)
indicator-height.description: How far up the screen the indicator sits. Low numbers are lower down. Default 17.

indicator-hold.name: Indicator Hold Time
indicator-hold.description: How long the indicator stays visible, in seconds.

play-sound.name: Play Sound On Switch
play-sound.description: Play a short sound when the StartPos changes.

sound.name: Switch Sound
sound.description: Which sound plays on a switch.

show-label.name: Show On-Screen Label
show-label.description: The classic label: the current StartPos and how many deaths are left until the next switch.

label-size.name: Label Size
label-size.description: Text size of the label. Default 0.3.

label-color.name: Label Color
label-color.description: theme uses your theme's accent colour.

show-total-deaths.name: Label: Show Total Deaths
show-total-deaths.description: Add a session death counter to the label (every death is counted).

track-stats.name: Track StartPos Stats
track-stats.description: Counts deaths and best percent only for runs started from a StartPos. Kept in memory while you play and saved when you leave the level, so it adds no lag.

show-stats-button.name: Stats Button On Level Page
show-stats-button.description: Adds a small button to the level page (before you press play) that opens your StartPos stats.

menu-style.name: Menu Style
menu-style.description: solid = opaque panel. glass = see-through panel. outline = very light panel. Applies to the in-game menu and the stats popup.

show-pause-panel.name: Show Pause Panel
show-pause-panel.description: The small panel in the pause menu with the on/off checkbox and a Menu button.

show-main-menu-button.name: Main Menu Button
show-main-menu-button.description: Adds an 'SP' button to the main menu that opens the Random StartPos menu.

reset-on-disable.name: Return To 0% When Turned Off
reset-on-disable.description: When you turn the mod off, put your next respawn back at the very start of the level if the mod had moved you to a StartPos.

compat-warning.name: Compatibility Warning
compat-warning.description: When you enter a level, warn if another StartPos mod (Smart StartPos, StartPos Switcher) may be on, because they fight over where you respawn.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes short lines to the Geode log when StartPos are found, deaths are detected and StartPos are switched. Turn it on and send the log if something doesn't work.
